blocks.text: At Vogueritual, we are committed to providing clear shipping information and a convenient delivery experience for our customers.
This Shipping & Delivery Policy applies to purchases made through https://vogueritual.us.

International shipping is not available.

pages.title: Order Cancellation Policy
intro: At Vogueritual, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel an order.
pages.description: At Vogueritual, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel an order.

blocks.text: At Vogueritual, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel an order.
This policy explains how to request cancellation and what happens when an order has already been shipped.
Contact our customer support team as soon as possible.
Email: info@vogueritual.us
Please provide your order number and the email address used at checkout.
Orders that have not yet shipped may be eligible for cancellation.
Approval depends on whether fulfillment can still be stopped.
A cancellation request is not confirmed until our support team communicates that the order has been canceled.
Our standard handling period is 1–3 business days.
If an order is being prepared, contact us immediately to request cancellation.
We will review its status and confirm the available options.
Once an order has been dispatched, cancellation may no longer be possible.
If the package is already in transit, customers may request an eligible return after delivery under our 30-day Returns & Refunds Policy.
We do not advertise a separate cancellation fee for successfully canceled orders.
If a paid order is successfully canceled, any applicable refund will normally be issued to the original payment method.
Refunds will be handled according to the circumstances, our published policies, and applicable legal requirements.
If a product is unavailable after an order is placed, we will review the order and communicate the available options.
An appropriate refund will be provided where required.
If an order cannot be shipped within the applicable promised or legally required period, customers will be provided with legally required notices and cancellation or refund options.
If you need to change your delivery address or order information, contact us promptly.
Shipping address changes cannot be made after dispatch under our published shipping policy.
Email: info@vogueritual.us
Website: https://vogueritual.us
2260 Porter Way
